Persist the flags in ClusterConfiguration.apiServer.extraArgs, fail closed, gate it in verify-cluster.sh and document the post-upgrade check. No cluster is available; live verification is listed, not claimed.

events.provenance: kubeadm API reference kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta4 (https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/config-api/kubeadm-config.v1beta4/), fetched by the coordinator on 2026-10-31 (the implementation lane could not read it and had relied on the repo's own 02-init-cluster.sh, which already renders v1beta4)
events.summary: In v1beta4 ControlPlaneComponent.extraArgs is a list of {name, value} (v1beta3 used a map), and extraVolumes entries are {name, hostPath, mountPath, readOnly, pathType}. 02-init-cluster.sh uses the list form for the apiserver already, so the helper merges into that list, replaces oidc-* entries and also handles a v1beta3 map; any other apiVersion or shape is refused. The reference states: Arg = {name (required), value (required)}; ControlPlaneComponent.extraArgs is []Arg, 'Extra arguments will override existing default arguments. Duplicate extra arguments are allowed.'; extraVolumes is []HostPathMount {name, hostPath, mountPath, readOnly, pathType}; v1.31 changelog: string/string extraArgs maps were replaced by structured arguments that support duplicates. Because duplicates are allowed, the helper replaces every existing oidc-* entry rather than appending.

scripts/cluster/11-4c-kubeadm-config-oidc.sh reads data.ClusterConfiguration and resourceVersion, refuses unparsable input, an unknown kind or apiVersion, two documents and an unexpected extraArgs shape, replaces only oidc-* entries with the seven flags, proves the merge changed nothing else, backs the original up, patches data.ClusterConfiguration only (pinned to the read resourceVersion), re-reads and requires exactly the seven flags. It refuses to write when a readable local apiserver manifest has no volumeMount covering /etc/kubernetes/pki. 11-4 calls it once and exits 1 on failure; apply-apiserver-oidc-kakao.sh checks it is staged before the first restart and runs it on master-1; verify-cluster.sh compares the ClusterConfiguration flags with the expected seven. R290b gains a flag-mismatch case and the apply script's two-masters-never-down comment is limited to the case where the PID is readable.
